find_artworks_by_artist.description: List the works one artist made. The Met's own search matches titles and descriptions as well as artist names, so this action checks who is actually credited on each result and keeps only the real matches: searching 'Rembrandt' returns his etchings, not every print that mentions him. Works with a surname on its own as well as a full name.

search_artworks.description: Search The Met's collection of more than 500,000 objects. Every filter is optional and they combine: narrow by department, medium or object type, where the work comes from, and when it was made, and keep only the museum's highlights, the works on view, or the ones it has photographed. Returns the artworks themselves, not just ID numbers, with the total number of matches and the offset for the next page.

description: Search and browse The Metropolitan Museum of Art's collection of more than 500,000 objects through its public Collection API. Find artworks by subject, artist, department, medium, place or period; list the museum's highlights and what is on view in the galleries today; pull a full catalogue record; track the records The Met has just revised; and get direct links to the open-access images. No account or API key is required.
